newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aetna started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aetna started as hold.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers managed healthcare analyst Robert Hoehn said he started coverage of Aetna Inc with a hold rating.
-- Shares in the managed healthcare and insurance giant were up 1/8 to 75-5/8.

-- "While we see the company evolving into one of the truly national managed care companies in a rapidly consolidating industry, we believe that there may be some short-term disappointment with the company's earnings in the fourth quarter and the enrollment trends for early 1997," Hoehn said.
-- "As a result, we believe that the stock may pull back over the next several months and present a better buying opportunity at around the $65 level," he said.
